title: Runtime evidence
responsibility: Combines recorded screenshots, behavior and audio while identifying evidence gaps and offline copies.

inputs.name: RuntimeEvidence.entity
inputs.description: Entity whose kind informs notices and category chooses panels. Pages/shells/components are visual; functions have no screenshot panel and scope behavior rows by identifier.

inputs.name: RuntimeEvidence.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplying offline status and cache timestamp for the saved-copy warning.

inputs.name: RuntimeEvidence.evidence
inputs.description: State whose ready result feeds the panels and whose status/error feeds notices. A notice takes precedence over results.

outputs.name: RuntimeEvidence
outputs.description: Runtime section identifying current tip or commit/parent. Labels offline content as saved and not server-checked. Shows screenshots for non-functions that are visual or declare screen options; behavior for nonvisual entities or existing behavior rows; audio when appropriate. Uses recorded runtime evidence, not proposed designs.
